title: The Battle in the Valley
reflectionText: Israel looked small beside an army that filled the country, but the battle answered Syria’s claim that Yahweh ruled the hills and not the valleys. The victory was meant to make Yahweh known. Where are you tempted to measure what is possible only by what appears largest before you?
editorialNotes: Packet 022 initial writer output. Short-only plan. The retelling stays within 1 Kings 20:22-34 and preserves the warning, Syria’s claim, the battle at Aphek, Ben Hadad’s plea, and Ahab’s covenant without importing the following prophetic judgment.
